name: Preacher
summary: Preacher; Allies within 30 ft gain advantage on fear saves while you are conscious.  Preacher; When you use Martyr’s Mercy, the target also gains advantage on its next saving throw against fear.  Preacher; Once per long rest, as an action, up to three allies within 30 ft regain hit points equal to 2d6 + your Wisdom or Charisma modifier.  Preacher; Allies within 30 ft also gain +1d4 to fear saves.
descriptionMarkdown:
Preacher; Allies within 30 ft gain advantage on fear saves while you are conscious.

Preacher; When you use Martyr’s Mercy, the target also gains advantage on its next saving throw against fear.

Preacher; Once per long rest, as an action, up to three allies within 30 ft regain hit points equal to 2d6 + your Wisdom or Charisma modifier.

Preacher; Allies within 30 ft also gain +1d4 to fear saves.
